source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: You test a new skill on an easy source using a stronger model, then test without the skill on a difficult source using a cheaper model. The first output is better. What should you do next?

options.text: Conclude that the skill caused the improvement because its output was better
options.feedback: Task difficulty and model choice changed too, so the observed difference cannot be attributed clearly to the skill.

options.text: Repeat with matched sources and comparable model settings
options.feedback: A matched comparison reduces competing explanations and lets you examine whether the skill improves the results.

options.text: Conclude that the stronger model caused every observed difference between outputs
options.feedback: The model is one possible influence, but the task and skill also changed. This comparison cannot isolate any one cause.

options.text: Average the output lengths to estimate how much quality the skill added
options.feedback: Length is not a substitute for task-specific quality criteria, and averaging it does not remove the mismatched conditions.
